summary: Six rounds on the on-art contrast audit (6158aab..b3a73d8). Rounds 1-5 fix-first (7, 6, 5, 4, 3 findings), each fixed and re-verified by the reviewer's own harness and, for paint order and the glow falloff, in Chromium.
